aggregation_to_tracts: Pixel-center mean inside tract polygon from NLCD TCC 2021 WCS window.
definition: Percent of each 30 m raster cell covered by tree canopy; tract value is mean of WCS pixel centers falling inside the tract polygon.
phoenix_local_canopy_difference: Phoenix local canopy uses OHR shade-study TREE_PCT_N over plantable ground; not reused here.
resolution: 30 m source; WCS window nearest-neighbor export
source_selected: NLCD / USDA Forest Service Percent Tree Canopy Cover (CONUS) via MRLC WCS mrlc_download:nlcd_tcc_conus_2021_v2021-4
vintage: 2021 NLCD TCC for comparable four-city baseline
